title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the wavelength using λ = v/f, yielding 2 m.

title: Number of constructive points
description: Essential: The student must state there are 3 points of constructive interference on the S1-S2 line.

title: Distances from S1
description: Essential: The student must list the correct distances of the constructive points from S1 as 1 m, 2 m, and 3 m.

title: Constructive interference condition
description: Important: The student must apply the condition for constructive interference, |S2P - S1P| = nλ, where n is an integer.

title: Points on circumference count
description: Important: The student must correctly determine there are 6 enhancement points on the circle (excluding S1 and S2).

title: Geometry for circle points
description: Important: The student must reason that points on the circle satisfy a constant path difference, leading to specific angular positions.

title: Midpoint analysis
description: Optional: The student may explicitly verify that point B (the midpoint) is a point of constructive interference.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work shows consistent use of units (m, Hz, m/s) in calculations.

title: Incorrect path difference
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the condition for destructive interference or misapplies the path difference formula.

title: Forgetting to exclude sources
description: Pitfall: The student counts the wave source positions S1 and S2 as enhancement points on the circumference.
